name: Sanctions & coercion
value: US blockade of Iran; Graham Act in force
summary: US naval blockade of Iran continues; ending it and sanctions is among Iran's seven demands
state: The US naval blockade of Iranian ports remains in force, and Iran's 5 Nov proposal via Qatar makes ending it, lifting sanctions and releasing frozen assets conditions for talks (Fox News). Washington is reviewing the proposal. Wider secondary sanctions on Russia and Iran remain in place. No major economy has been cut off from payment systems as of 6 Nov.
for_you: Firms trading with Iran or Russia face secondary-sanction risk. Ordinary consumers feel it mainly through energy and shipping costs.
